posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked:
You find in your Google Calendar but if not there then no problem just make a meeting link by yourself and follow the rules given in YouTube video.

There is no problem if you go through any random meeting link because that link is for just comfort so, that student don’t need to make Link by yourself nothing else.
